Act.description:
ZC_NOTIFY_ACT (0x08C8 at this PACKETVER; 0x008A / 0x02E1 on older clients): `src_gid` acts
on `target_gid` -- a hit or a miss, an item pickup, sitting down or standing up.

damage.description: 0 is a miss; -1 is a hidden amount (a disguised source).

dmotion.description: The target's damage motion, ms: how long a hit stuns it.

kind.description: The action's name: normal, pickup, sit, stand, endure, splash, single, repeat, multi_hit, multi_hit_endure, critical, lucky_dodge, touch, multi_hit_critical, splash_endure, or typeN for an unknown one.

server_tick.description: gettick() of the action, mod 2^32 (0 for sit, stand and pickup).

sp_damage.description: The damage hits SP (blue digits); 0x08C8 only.

src_speed.description: The source's attack motion, ms (rAthena amotion).

t_mono_ns.description: Kernel receive time mapped onto CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

target_gid.description: The target's block id; the floor item's id for a pickup; 0 for sit/stand.

Act.title: Act

AttackRequest.description:
CZ_REQUEST_ACT2 (0x0437): an action on a unit -- an attack click (action 0 once, 7 keep
attacking), or sit (2) / stand (3) with no target. A walk click is a self_move_request.

kind.description: The action's name (decode.ACT_KINDS): normal, repeat, sit, ...

t_mono_ns.description: Kernel receive time mapped onto CLOCK_MONOTONIC.

target_gid.description: The target's block id (0 for sit/stand).

gid.description: Block id (rAthena bl.id): the id vanish/stop packets use.

heading.description: Heading 0..7 (0 = north, counter-clockwise) for new/stand entries; a walking entity faces its step (derived downstream).
